titulo: Angus Taylor insists he made no payments to conservative Liberal group amid Icac investigation
cuerpo: Opposition leader says he is ‘not a party to proceedings’ being investigated by NSW corruption watchdog as fellow Liberals close ranks Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Angus Taylor says no payments were made in relation to a growing corruption case involving members of the New South Wales Liberal party, insisting he is not a party to the proceedings. Fellow Liberals also closed ranks around the federal opposition leader, sidestepping questions about the hearing by noting his statements and the fact he is not a party to the corruption inquiry’s work.
